dictionary.h_calm: No threats: your home is protected and I keep checking the network.
dictionary.h_watch: I noticed unusual activity. I am keeping an eye on it, nothing to do for now.
dictionary.h_alert: Someone is trying to get in. I already set temporary defences and you can undo them any time.
dictionary.h_attack: An attack is in progress. I am defending on my own: I block, slow down or isolate the attacker without touching your devices.
dictionary.h_observing: I am only observing: automatic defence is off, I block nothing until you turn it on.
dictionary.s_alert: Attention, someone is trying to get into the network. I am defending.
dictionary.s_attack: Attention, an attack is in progress. I am defending and your devices are safe.
dictionary.left: {{minutes}} min left, then it switches off by itself
dictionary.hint: Drag to rotate, tap a point for details. Press Esc to close.
